investigation_notes.Description: An unusual volume of SharePoint file downloads (420) was observed from Linda.Kask@globalcorp.ee, significantly above the 24-hour baseline of 45. The activity involved downloading multiple sensitive documents from the Finance Reporting site via SharePoint Online on FIN-LAPTOP-09, with the destination pointing to a Microsoft data center. While the destination is expected for SharePoint, the spike could indicate data exfiltration or policy misuse; this requires confirmation of user intent and data sensitivity, so the alert is prioritized for investigation.
